Name: Maachah, Wife of Machir
Summary: Wife of Machir who bore Peresh, and sister of Huppim and Shuppim.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:15; 1 Chronicles 7:16: Wife of Machir who bore Peresh, and sister of Huppim and Shuppim.
LifeLesson: The mention of Maachah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
